newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SES sets brokerage rate for listed unit trusts.
newsitem.headline: SES sets brokerage rate for listed unit trusts.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) said on Wednesday brokerage rates for the Singapore Regional Index (SRI) Fund would be at 0.5 percent for the first Singapore $250,000.
SES said in a statement that brokerage rate for amounts over S$250,000 would be at 0.3 percent. Trades would be subjected to a minimum brokerage of S$2.00 per contract.
A managing director of a local firm saw the move as a SES "incentive for investors to trade in the SRI Fund".
The SRI Fund raised a record of S$249 million. It will start trading on a "when issued" basis on December 20.
